✓ 2000 Danish euro referendum.subject: World History
✓ 2000 Danish euro referendum.question: In March 2000, as the euro was being launched, the Danish government led by _____, a supporter of the common currency, decided to hold a referendum on Danish entry into the monetary union
✓ 2000 Danish euro referendum.fact: In March 2000, as the euro was being launched, the Danish government led by Poul Nyrup Rasmussen, a supporter of the common currency, decided to hold a referendum on Danish entry into the monetary union.

✓ 2000 Danish euro referendum.question: According to the bill, if the outcome of the referendum was in favour of the adoption of the euro, _____ would be able to join the euro area from 1 January 2002 with the euro as "book money"
✓ 2000 Danish euro referendum.fact: This meant that, among three other areas, Denmark would not be part of the European Monetary Union (EMU). According to the bill, if the outcome of the referendum was in favour of the adoption of the euro, Denmark would be able to join the euro area from 1 January 2002 with the euro as "book money".
